definition: An application pool groups web applications under shared worker-process settings and isolates their execution from applications in separate pools.
entry_text: An application pool groups web applications under shared worker-process settings and isolates their execution from applications in separate pools.
example: An IIS administrator places a billing site in its own application pool so recycling its worker does not restart the document portal.
label: Application pool
sense_note: The usual sense is Microsoft's IIS hosting concept.
